title: PTE Normalised Parking Telemetry Event
description: One parking telemetry event: a bay being used, or a bay being left. Emitted identically by both harvester modes so a downstream consumer cannot tell whether the transition came from live snapshot-diffing or from a historical parking-event archive. AVAILABILITY LANE ONLY - this schema deliberately contains no legality verdict field, and every event carries legalityClaimed=false. Restriction and overstay are carried as observed inventory/metadata, never as a verdict; legality comes from the deterministic rule kernel.

eventType.description: ARRIVAL = bay became used. DEPARTURE = bay became free. PARKING_EVENT = a historical archive row that already pairs an arrival with a departure. STATUS_UNKNOWN_TRANSITION = status changed to or from a value that is neither free nor occupied (e.g. Restricted, Unofficial, sensor fault); recorded rather than guessed.

sourceMode.description: Provenance of the transition. Determines what timeConfidence is achievable.

bayKey.description: Stable per-bay identifier from the source (Melbourne: marker_id / kerbside_id / bay_id). The join key for occupancy-to-geometry work.

sourceId.description: Dataset or feed identifier, e.g. on-street-parking-bay-sensors or melbourne-2020-jan-may.

betweenStreet1.description: Cross street bounding the kerb span. Present in Melbourne archives.

restriction.description: OBSERVED inventory metadata only (e.g. 1P, 2P, Loading Zone). NOT a legality verdict. Values ending in 'OLD' mean the restriction changed after the event or the sensor was replaced - see dataQuality sign_old_suffix.

overstay.description: Publisher-supplied overstay flag where available. An observation about a past event, not a determination about a proposed future interval, so it must not feed the legality kernel.

fromStatus.description: live-diff only: status before the transition.

toStatus.description: live-diff only: status after the transition.

observedAt.description: live-diff only: when the transition was observed.

observationWindowSeconds.description: live-diff only: the poll interval that bounds the true transition time. The real event happened somewhere inside this window; its exact time is UNKNOWN.

durationSeconds.description: Stay duration. MAY BE NEGATIVE in source data - a documented Melbourne sensor fault where arrival was detected after departure. Flagged as negative_duration and never silently coerced to zero.

timeConfidence.description: The single most important field in this schema. OBSERVED = real sensor timestamp. EPOCH = numeric timestamp. DERIVED = inferred by diffing two state snapshots, bounded by the poll interval. IMPUTED = publisher calculated it from midnight because the sensor time was not recorded; NOT an observation. UNPARSEABLE/MISSING = no usable time. Any hour-of-day or stay-duration analysis must stratify on this field or it will silently mix observed and imputed data.

sourceHealth.description: Matches the PTE source-health vocabulary. Derived from the lag between poll time and the newest source 'lastupdated' value, because the publisher warns this feed goes through network relays and can be disrupted.

dataQuality.description: Defect flags. Counted and surfaced, never silently dropped. The first four correspond to defects the City of Melbourne documents for its own archives; cross_year_excluded records the publisher's year-boundary truncation, which right-censors the stay distribution.

deviceId.description: crowdsourced mode only. Must be pseudonymised before persistence.

synthetic.description: true when the event came from tools/realtime-sim rather than a real source.

legalityClaimed.description: Always false. A structural assertion of the README invariant that occupancy and availability evidence can never determine legality. If this is ever true, the event is invalid.

then.description: A historical row must carry at least one of an arrival time or a duration, otherwise the harvester skips it as no_time_information.
